description: This Java source file defines the ReferenceController class, a Spring MVC Controller that provides endpoints for retrieving reference data such as provinces, country names, zone names, credit card expiration years, and months. It utilizes dependency-injected services and caching utilities to serve dynamic reference information relevant to an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: Controller handling reference data endpoints for provinces, country names, zone names, and credit card expiration info.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve provinces (zones) for a given country code and language, returning data as JSON.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Returns the localized name for a given country code, or defaults to the code if not found.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Returns the localized name for a given zone code, or defaults to the code if not found.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Provides a JSON list of upcoming credit card expiration years, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of months (1-12), cached for performance.
